card.name: Linking words before risk-condition terms
card.fires_on: The punctuation or small linking word just before a named risk condition, such as the period-comma in "e.g.," or "of" after "family history". It appears in contraindication and risk-factor lists, especially for QT prolongation and iron overload.

modes.label: After e.g.
modes.description: The ".," ending "e.g." that introduces an example condition in a risk or contraindication list.

modes.label: Of or as after history or risk
modes.description: The word "of" or "as" after "family history", "at risk" or "also known", leading into a condition name.
modes.example: and family history<< of>> QT abnormality. Hypokalemia

card.writes: It seems to prime the model for a specific condition or name coming next, such as a rare syndrome or label term.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a list of risk conditions or inherited conditions is about to name one.
